title: Jinhuang San alleviates plasma cell mastitis by restoring Th17/Treg balance through the HTR7/IL-6/JAK2/STAT3 axis.
authors: Meng, Ziqi; Liu, Mengli; Weng, Xiyu; Wu, Linfeng; Wu, Huanglei; Xue, Rong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究金黄散通过HTR7/IL-6/JAK2/STAT3轴调节Th17/Treg平衡治疗浆细胞性乳腺炎，虽含分子对接但核心为免疫机制与湿实验，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Jinhuang San (JHS) is a traditional topical medication for "mastitis". It is currently used in the treatment of plasma cell mastitis (PCM), but its mechanism remains unclear. AIM OF THE STUDY: This study aimed to investigate the therapeutic mechanism of JHS in PCM through chemical characterization, immune microenvironment analysis, and experimental validation. MATERIALS AND METHODS: The chemical constituents of JHS were characterized by UPLC-Q-Orbitrap-MS/MS. A PCM-like mouse model was established by intraductal injection of human PCM-derived breast tissue homogenate emulsified with complete Freund's adjuvant. JHS was topically administered for 7 consecutive days. Transcriptomic sequencing and public single-cell RNA-seq data were integrated to profile the immune microenvironment. A macrophage-CD4(+) T cell co-culture system was established, and LP-44 (a selective HTR7 agonist) together with recombinant IL-6 was used for mechanistic validation. An in silico HTR7 perturbation analysis was also performed. RESULTS: 30 major constituents were identified in JHS. Single-cell reanalysis indicated prominent macrophage infiltration and Th17/Treg imbalance in PCM. Molecular docking suggested potential interactions between several identified constituents and HTR7. In vivo and in vitro experiments showed that JHS reduced HTR7 expression, decreased IL-6 production, and attenuated JAK2/STAT3 phosphorylation; these effects were partially reversed by LP-44 or recombinant IL-6. Virtual HTR7 knockout altered immune-related genes (IL-6, JAK2, STAT3, FOXP3) and enriched Th17 pathways. CONCLUSION: JHS alleviated experimental PCM and restored Th17/Treg balance, potentially through modulation of the HTR7/IL-6/JAK2/STAT3 axis in macrophages. These findings provide an experimental basis for further clinical evaluation of JHS in PCM.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：金黄散（JHS）是一种用于治疗“乳腺炎”的传统外用药物。目前用于治疗浆细胞性乳腺炎（PCM），但其机制尚不明确。研究目的：本研究旨在通过化学成分表征、免疫微环境分析和实验验证，探讨JHS在PCM中的治疗机制。材料与方法：采用UPLC-Q-Orbitrap-MS/MS对JHS的化学成分进行表征。通过向小鼠乳腺导管内注射人PCM来源的乳腺组织匀浆（与完全弗氏佐剂乳化）建立PCM样小鼠模型。JHS连续外用给药7天。整合转录组测序和公共单细胞RNA-seq数据，以描绘免疫微环境。建立巨噬细胞-CD4(+) T细胞共培养体系，并使用LP-44（一种选择性HTR7激动剂）和重组IL-6进行机制验证。还进行了计算机模拟HTR7扰动分析。结果：在JHS中鉴定出30种主要成分。单细胞重分析表明PCM中巨噬细胞浸润显著，且存在Th17/Treg失衡。分子对接提示多种已鉴定成分与HTR7之间存在潜在相互作用。体内和体外实验表明，JHS降低了HTR7表达、减少了IL-6产生，并减弱了JAK2/STAT3磷酸化；这些效应可被LP-44或重组IL-6部分逆转。虚拟HTR7敲除改变了免疫相关基因（IL-6、JAK2、STAT3、FOXP3）并富集了Th17通路。结论：JHS缓解了实验性PCM并恢复了Th17/Treg平衡，其机制可能涉及调节巨噬细胞中的HTR7/IL-6/JAK2/STAT3轴。这些发现为JHS在PCM中的进一步临床评估提供了实验基础。
